meta.title: 自由泳转身对比：错误 vs 正确
meta.title_en: Freestyle Flip Turn: Wrong vs Right

scenes.context: 分屏对比：上格红叉（问题动作）、下格绿勾（正确示范），两位泳者同步冲向池壁。错误组团身偏松，正确组团身紧凑。
sentences: 上格红叉是问题动作，下格绿勾是正确示范。
Top: red cross for the flawed turn; bottom: green check for the model.
flawed（有缺陷的）
两位泳者同步冲向池壁。
Both swimmers sprint toward the wall in sync.
in sync（同步）
scenes.speak: Top: red cross for the flawed turn; bottom: green check for the model. Both swimmers sprint toward the wall in sync.

scenes.context: 冲刺阶段两组动作同步性很高，差异尚未显现。这时候还看不出对错，关键在于团身阶段。
sentences: 冲刺阶段，两组动作高度同步。
In the sprint phase, both groups move in sync.
sprint（冲刺）
差异还没显现，关键在团身。
No gap yet—the tuck decides everything.
tuck（团身）
scenes.speak: In the sprint phase, both groups move in sync. No gap yet—the tuck decides everything.

scenes.title_cn: 团身瞬间：松 vs 紧
scenes.context: 团身瞬间：上格更立、更松、离墙更远；下格更贴、更紧凑。正确做法是膝盖收向胸口、全身缩成一团，越紧凑滚翻越快。
sentences: 上格更立更松、离墙更远。
The top is more upright, looser and farther from the wall.
upright（竖直）
下格更贴、更紧凑。
The bottom hugs closer and tighter.
compact（紧凑）
团身越紧，滚翻越快。
A tighter tuck spins you faster.
spin（滚翻）
scenes.speak: The top is more upright, looser and farther from the wall. The bottom hugs closer and tighter. A tighter tuck spins you faster.

scenes.context: 翻滚中段：上格团身持续偏松，下格持续保持紧凑。松散的团身会让身体在滚翻中展开，损失角速度。
sentences: 上格持续偏松，滚翻变慢。
The loose tuck keeps the flip slow.
loose tuck（松散团身）
下格全程紧凑，速度不掉。
The bottom stays compact and fast throughout.
throughout（全程）
scenes.speak: The loose tuck keeps the flip slow. The bottom stays compact and fast throughout.

scenes.context: 蹬壁对比：上格蹬得更早、离墙更远；下格贴墙更久才出发。正确做法是等双脚贴稳墙再发力，蹬得更远更扎实。
sentences: 上格蹬得早、离墙远，力量浪费。
The top pushes early and far from the wall—wasted power.
wasted（浪费的）
下格贴墙更久，蹬得更扎实。
The bottom hugs the wall longer for a solid push.
solid push（扎实蹬壁）
scenes.speak: The top pushes early and far from the wall—wasted power. The bottom hugs the wall longer for a solid push.

practice: A tighter tuck spins you faster.
Hug the wall longer for a solid push.
Sprint in sync, then tuck tight.
pitfalls: 团身松会拉长半径转不快
Pressing both feet against the wall
翻滚中展开会损失角速度
Spotting the wall with your eyes
shifts: 现在团身紧、贴墙久，一滚一带
现在追求滚翻速度+蹬壁质量
footer_notes: 转身对比的本质：松散团身 vs 紧凑团身。团身越紧滚翻越快、贴墙越久蹬壁越有力——差的就是这两点。
